prompt: What is the current age of the last American experimental physicist to win the Nobel Prize in Physics?
answer: The last American experimental physicist to win the Nobel Prize in Physics is **Francis Halzen**, who received the **2026 Nobel Prize** for his work on the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. Born **March 23, 1944**, he is **82 years old as of October 28, 2026**.
